name: Righteous Living
overview: Scripture reveals that righteous living is marked by God's blessing and protection over those who walk in His ways, as seen in Psalms 5:12 where the Lord surrounds the righteous as with a shield. Believers are called to live by the Spirit to overcome fleshly desires (Galatians 5:16) and to put away bitterness, wrath, and malice (Ephesians 4:31), promoting peace rather than strife (Proverbs 16:28). The principle of sowing and reaping underscores the moral order God upholds (Galatians 6:7), culminating in the glorious judgment of Christ (Matthew 25:31) where the righteous will be honored.
